<!-- Search existing issues first. Remove secrets, personal data, and private application details. -->

## Problem

Describe the problem and what you expected to happen.

## Reproduction

Include a minimal .serializer schema, relevant consumer code or input, and exact
commands or steps. For accessibility barriers, name the affected page or tool and
describe the task you could not complete; screenshots are optional.

## Actual behavior

Include the error message or output as text when possible.

## Environment

- Serializer commit or release:
- Operating system and architecture:
- Compiler/runtime and CMake versions (if relevant):
- Output language, naming profile, and generator options (if relevant):
- Protocol and compression settings (if relevant):
- Browser, editor, or assistive technology and version (if relevant):

## Additional context

Does this reproduce on the latest main revision? Include a known working revision,
workaround, or related issue if available. Say if you could not check.
